sara: Heads-up postmortem follow-up 8GPU/autoscale9. Want to lock a remediation cadence: weekly 45m triage + biweekly deep dives. Agree? :calendar:

tzahi: Agree. Please include quota guardrails and scheduler knobs in agenda.

kevin: Ill take scheduler tuning. Plan: threshold sweep, preemption windows, pod-priority matrix, and a perf test. Aiming for a PR with knobs + unit tests by 2026-03-27.

john: Ill own headroom planning and forecast. Ill drop a 4-week ramp doc with short/med risk scenarios by 2026-03-25.

lia: Product needs clear quota language + fallback UX for Dedicated customers. I can draft wording + a customer-facing fallback doc by 2026-03-31.

sara: Creating action IDs for tracking: A1 scheduler tuning (kevin) due 2026-03-27, A2 quota soft-caps + backstop (tzahi) due 2026-04-01, A3 headroom forecast (john) due 2026-03-25, A4 surge runbook snippets (ani) due 2026-04-07, A5 pre-deploy capacity gate (lia) due 2026-03-30. Ill add to the tracker.

kevin: Need perf harness updates to emulate prefix-heavy customer traffic. Sample config: 
```
load_profile: "prefix-heavy"
concurrency: [50,200]
sequence_lengths: [64,512]
quant_modes: [int8, fp16]
```

kevin: @ops-bot can you reserve a stress window for the perf run?

ops-bot: stress-test-schedule: reserved 2026-03-29T03:00:00Z - 2026-03-29T04:00:00Z. Alerts -> #eng-oncall & #incidents. :rocket:

ani: Ill draft runbook snippets: quick rollback, model fallback (smaller variant), cache warmup, and a hot-path checklist.

tzahi: Quota guardrail sketch: tenant-level soft cap with token leaky-bucket; escalate to hard backstop when cluster headroom < 5%. Emergency eviction for low-priority jobs.

sara: Recurring patterns observed: spikes align with scheduled deploys and daily 09:00 UTC batch jobs. Action: add pre-deploy headroom CI check -> A5 (lia).

lia: Ack. Will add CI gate checklist + a UI override flag for SREs.

kevin: After perf run Ill post PR + thresholds. If perf delta > 15% we revert kernel tweak.

john: Headroom doc will include week-by-week ramp, buffer targets (baseline 10%, surge buffer 20%), and hot-standby node proposals. Uploading to /wiki/capacity/headroom-2026 by COB 2026-03-25.

sara: Scheduling a 30m handoff Fri 09:00 PT to confirm owners and runbook content. Recurring weekly triage set. Invite sent.

kevin: Add metric thresholds to runbook: queue length > 120 per-AZ, avg tail p99 > 800ms, GPU util > 88% for >5m -> escalate to oncall.

ani: Will add the thresholds and playbook actions.

sara: Thanks all. Ill update master tracker Monday AM and ping owners. Reply here if you have blockers. :white_check_mark:
